```{r fig.width=12, fig.height=7}

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(readr)
  library(dplyr)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(forcats)
  library(scales)
})


als_vax <- read.csv("~/scenario-modelling-of-vaccination-and-NPIs/output/als_&_vax_bar.csv")
early_booster <- read.csv("~/scenario-modelling-of-vaccination-and-NPIs/output/early_booster_bar.csv")
natl_vax_rate <- read.csv("~/scenario-modelling-of-vaccination-and-NPIs/output/natl_vax_rate_bar.csv")

merged <- rbind(als_vax, early_booster, natl_vax_rate)
#compare_bars <- write.csv(merged, "~/scenario-modelling-of-vaccination-and-NPIs/output/compare_bars.csv", row.names = FALSE)

# ---- clean & order factors
df2 <- merged %>%
  mutate(
    vax = factor(vax, levels = c("0%","25%","50%","75%","100%")),
    als_scen = factor(als_scen, levels = c("No-ALS Only", "ALS-2 Only", "Implemented ALS", "ALS-4 Only")),
    period = factor(period, levels = c("Up to March 14, 2022", "March 15 - Dec 02, 2022")),
    type = fct_recode(
      factor(type), 
      "Observed ALS & vax" = "als_&_vax",
      "Early boosters"            = "early boosters",
      "National vaccination rate" = "natl rate vax"
    ),
    type = fct_relevel(type, "Observed ALS & vax", "Early boosters", "Nationalvaccination rate")
  )

# ---- plot ----
p <- ggplot(df2, aes(x = vax, y = total_infections, fill = type)) +
  geom_col(position = position_dodge(width = 0.85), width = 0.78, colour = "grey20", linewidth = 0.25) +
  facet_grid(period ~ als_scen, scales = "free_y") +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = comma) +
  labs(
    x = "Vaccination scale (relative to observed NL daily rate)",
    y = "Total infections",
    fill = NULL
  ) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x       = element_text(size = 8,  hjust = 0.5, margin = margin(t = 8)),
    axis.text.y       = element_text(size = 8),
    axis.title.x      = element_text(size = 8),
    axis.title.y      = element_text(size = 8),
    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.box = "vertical",
    legend.margin = margin(t = 2, r = 2, b = 2, l = 2),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold", size = 12),
    # strip.background  = element_blank(),
    axis.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
    panel.spacing     = unit(0.50, "cm"),
    plot.background   = element_blank()
  )

p

```

```{r}
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(dplyr)
  library(tidyr)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(readr)
  library(forcats)
  library(ggthemes)
  library(scales)
  library(grid)   # for unit()
})

options(scipen = 9999999)

## ---------------------------- paths ----------------------------------------

base_dir      <- "~/Documents/scenario-modelling-of-vaccination-and-NPIs/output"
baseline_file <- file.path(base_dir, "comb_vax_als_bars.csv")       # baseline rollout
early_file    <- file.path(base_dir, "early_boosters_bars.csv")     # early boosters

## ------------------------- load & clean ------------------------------------

als_vax_raw <- bind_rows(
  read_csv(baseline_file, show_col_types = FALSE),
  read_csv(early_file,    show_col_types = FALSE)
)

# standardize period labels
als_vax_clean <- als_vax_raw |>
  mutate(
    period = recode(
      period,
      "Up to March 14, 2022"     = "Dec 15–Mar 14",
      "March 15 – Nov 30, 2022"  = "Mar 15–Nov 30",
      "March 15 - Nov 30, 2022"  = "Mar 15–Nov 30"
    )
  )

## --------------------- normal vs early side by side ------------------------

als_vax_wide <- als_vax_clean |>
  select(als_scen, vaccination, period, type, total_infections) |>
  pivot_wider(
    names_from  = type,               # expects columns "normal" and "early"
    values_from = total_infections
  )

# difference > 0 means more infections under baseline than early boosters
als_vax_wide <- als_vax_wide |>
  mutate(diff = normal - early)

## ------------------- period-specific and total diffs -----------------------

period_diffs <- als_vax_wide |>
  select(als_scen, vaccination, period, diff)

total_diffs <- period_diffs |>
  group_by(als_scen, vaccination) |>
  summarise(diff = sum(diff, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") |>
  mutate(period = "Total (Dec 15–Nov 30)")

als_levels <- c("No-ALS Only", "ALS-2 Only", "Implemented ALS", "ALS-4 Only")

plot_df <- bind_rows(period_diffs, total_diffs) |>
  mutate(
    period = factor(
      period,
      levels = c("Dec 15–Mar 14",
                 "Mar 15–Nov 30",
                 "Total (Dec 15–Nov 30)")
    ),
    vaccination = factor(
      vaccination,
      levels = c("0%", "25%", "50%", "75%", "100%")
    ),
    als_scen = factor(als_scen, levels = als_levels)
  )

## ----------------------------- colours -------------------------------------

# okabe–ito style: colourblind-safe and high contrast
period_palette <- c(
  "Dec 15–Mar 14"         = "#0072B2",  # blue
  "Mar 15–Nov 30"         = "#009E73",  # green
  "Total (Dec 15–Nov 30)" = "#D55E00"   # vermilion
)

## ----------------------------- plot ----------------------------------------

p <- ggplot(
  plot_df,
  aes(x = vaccination, y = diff, fill = period)
) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linewidth = 0.4, colour = "grey40") +
  geom_col(
    position = position_dodge(width = 0.75),
    width    = 0.6
  ) +
  facet_wrap(~ als_scen, nrow = 2, scales = "free") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = period_palette, name = "Period") +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = comma) +
  labs(
    x     = "Vaccination coverage scenario",
    y     = expression(Delta * " infections (baseline - early boosters)"),
    title = "Difference in cumulative Omicron infections:\nbaseline vs. early booster rollout"
  ) +
  theme_clean() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x      = element_text(size = 16, angle = 0, hjust = 0.5),
    axis.text.y      = element_text(size = 16),
    axis.title.x     = element_text(size = 18),
    axis.title.y     = element_text(size = 18),
    plot.title       = element_text(size = 20, hjust = 0.5, face = "plain"),
    strip.text       = element_text(size = 18, face = "plain"),
    legend.position  = "top",
    legend.direction = "horizontal",
    legend.box       = "horizontal",
    legend.text      = element_text(size = 16),
    legend.title     = element_blank(),
    legend.background= element_blank(),
    plot.background  = element_blank(),
    panel.spacing.x  = unit(1.2, "cm"),
    panel.spacing.y  = unit(0.8, "cm")
  )

print(p)

## ---------------------------- export ---------------------------------------

png(
  "../figures/als_vax_early_total_diffs.png",
  width  = 3200,
  height = 1800,
  res    = 300,
  bg     = "white",
  type   = "cairo"
)
print(p)
dev.off()

```
